description: MainActivity.kt implements the main screen of an Android streaming app, including UI setup, banner fetching, and multiple data rails for categories like Trending, Drama, Horror, etc. It manages network requests via OkHttp, handles UI interactions, and updates content dynamically.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the main UI, network calls for banners and content rails, and navigation.

methods.name: setupPosterRail
methods.description: Helper to set up RecyclerView as a horizontal poster rail with spacing and click handler.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Launches ContentInfoActivity with selected item's details.

methods.name: fetchAllRails
methods.description: Initiates network requests for all content rails categories.

methods.name: setActiveNavHome
methods.description: Sets the navigation bar state to 'Home'.

methods.name: setNavColors
methods.description: Updates navigation item colors and font weights based on active selection.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Toggles visibility of banner loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Toggles visibility of error messages or retry UI.

methods.name: setBanners
methods.description: Updates banner carousel with fetched image URLs.

methods.name: parseBanners
methods.description: Parses banner URLs from JSON response.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Fetches banner URLs from server and updates UI.

methods.name: fetchRail
methods.description: Requests data for a specific content category, updating relevant UI if successful.

methods.name: attemptFetchRail
methods.description: Attempts fetch from fallback URLs sequentially until success or exhaustion.

methods.name: parsePosters
methods.description: Parses JSON data into list of poster items.
